subject: Geopolitics
title: Media Literacy
description: A quick win: understand Media Literacy.

hook.text: Finland teaches media literacy from age six. In global disinformation resilience rankings, it places first.

buildup.text: Media literacy means understanding how information is produced, who funds it, and what biases it carries.

discovery.text: Literate audiences spot manipulation: emotional framing, missing context, misleading stats, and false balance.

twist.text: Media literacy takes years to build. Disinformation campaigns take hours to launch. The defense is always slower.

climax.text: An informed citizenry is the strongest defense against propaganda. No algorithm can replace critical thinking.

punchline.text: Teach people to question and propaganda loses its power.

quiz.question: Why does Finland rank first in disinformation resilience?
options: It teaches media literacy from early childhood
It has no social media users
